BillHeading.Sponsors: Senators Honeyford, Hasegawa, Lovick, Mullet, Randall, Rolfes, and Wagoner

BillHistory.ReferredCommittee: Referred to Committee on State Government & Elections.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to designating a state nickname; and adding a new section to chapter 1.20 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 1.20 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: "The Evergreen State" is designated as the official nickname of the state of Washington.
